name: ARKO Petroleum Corp. Class A Common Stock
summary: ARKO Petroleum Corp. is a North American company specializing in fuel distribution, operating across three core segments: wholesale, fleet fueling, and GPMP. A significant portion of its business involves the fee-based wholesale supply of motor fuel, delivered both to its own retail sites and to external third-party dealers, all secured through long-term agreements. Founded in 2025, the company is headquartered in Richmond, Virginia, and functions as a subsidiary of Arko Convenience Stores LLC.
